purpose: Repair unintended orientation reversals within authored actions

sources.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production game sprite action repair for BOTANIST-FROG.
Reference image 1 is the approved character identity and clothing. Preserve species, exact facial features, silhouette proportions, costume, colors, outline style and all worn gear. Empty paws; no added objects, scenery or writing. Transparent RGBA background.
Create a clean atlas with SIX equal columns and 2 equal rows. One complete character in each cell, generous transparent gutters, no crop and no overlap.
CRITICAL ORIENTATION CONTRACT: lock the camera to the same RIGHT-facing side/three-quarter view in EVERY cell. The nose/muzzle points to SCREEN RIGHT in every frame. Tail/backpack/back of torso stay on SCREEN LEFT of the head. Do not mirror any cell; do not turn to face left or toward the camera. No roll onto the back, no somersault, no upright sprite rotated onto its side. No upside-down head or rotated facial features. The collapse is newly drawn articulated anatomy, gradually lowering forwards onto the paws while maintaining the original visible side.
Keep the same character scale across both rows. In standing/crouching frames feet are on a shared baseline; the body lowers naturally in resting frames rather than growing to fill the cell. Keep the same ground plane and right-facing head angle as the torso lowers.
ROW 1: DEATH, six frames left to right: (1) normal upright right-facing neutral stance; (2) knees buckle and torso leans slightly forwards toward screen right; (3) knees touch ground and paws reach forward toward screen right; (4) chest lowers onto bent forearms, head still at screen right; (5) body becomes fully prone with muzzle resting above the paws on the right; (6) settles gently in that same prone pose. Never fall backwards or roll.
ROW 2: UNCONSCIOUS, six frames left to right: the SAME fully prone belly-down resting pose as the preceding death row's final cell, with muzzle on SCREEN RIGHT throughout. Six different restrained breath phases: neutral, inhale, deeper inhale, apex, exhale, settled neutral. Body position stays planted. Only chest and eyelid/ear settling motion; no turning or head rolling.
In the final collapse pose and every unconscious pose, the head lies at the right, hind feet and tail at the left, paws under the right-facing muzzle; eyelids closed and body prone, belly down. The last collapse frame and the first unconscious frame must match orientation, anatomy, costume placement, body length and resting position. Only gentle breathing changes during the unconscious loop.
No blood, no stars, no motion lines, no floating gear, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows or painted backdrop. All 12 poses must be distinct, coherent motion poses.
